title: Ch06 §6.1.2: prove outsideIntegralIdeleUnits_isCompact and finitePlaceSchwartz_unitRelations_closure_eq
body:
Sweep of `RiemannMasullo/Ch06_LocalGlobal/Sec1.lean` (§6.1.2). Two statements proved; no statement changed.

Closes #4266
Closes #4278

- `outsideIntegralIdeleUnits_isCompact` ((6.1.2.2), p. 288): the group is the unit group of the submonoid `{a | a∞ = 1, a_S = 1, a_v ∈ O_v}` of the adeles, which is `{1} ×` a closed subset of the compact product of the local integer rings; `Submonoid.units_isCompact` finishes. One private helper (compactness of `∏ O_v` in the finite adeles), adapted from the private `isCompact_integralFiniteAdeles` in `AppA_AlgebraicNT/Sec1.lean`.
- `finitePlaceSchwartz_unitRelations_closure_eq` (Lemma 6.1.2.4(1), p. 291): `finitePlaceSchwartz_finestTopology` plus `finestLocallyConvex_submodule_isClosed`.

`#print axioms` on both: `[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]`.

Checks run: `lake build RiemannMasullo.Ch06_LocalGlobal.Sec1` (about 17 s, same as before the change), `scripts/lint.sh` (ok), and `scripts/signatures.sh --compare` on this module's signatures before and after (no changes; produced with `scripts/Signatures.lean` on this module only, since a full library build was not finished in this sandbox). The full `lake build` was not run.

The other claimed issues of this file (#4274, #4276, #4281, #4282, #4283, #4284, #4288) were released with notes.
